name: max parallel

on:
  push:

jobs:
  install-dependencies:
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 2
      matrix:
        node: [20, 21, 22, 23, 24]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
